_comment: PROPOSED EDGES — VERDICT NULL. Nothing here is on a row.
sources/scope.md, 'A machine classification never writes to the record': a proposal
goes to a file whose name says it is a proposal, with every verdict null, and a person
moves what survives review. This file is that, for the batteries census of 12-13
ONE EDGE, FROM THE QUANTUMSCAPE RULING OF 13 SEPTEMBER 2026. T&E's list carries
'QuantumScape Salzgitter' as a gigafactory entry. It is not one: QuantumScape licenses a
cell that PowerCo makes, and PowerCo's Salzgitter works is already a row here. The entry
is refused with the clause 'licensor, no works of its own', and the relationship the list
was pointing at is recorded here as an edge into the works rather than lost with the
`type: technology_licence` IS NEW, added to sector_map.EDGE_TYPES by the same ruling. It
is not `material`: nothing moves. A licence is a right to make something, and filing it
as a molecule would put a tonne on a graph that counts tonnes.
FIRMNESS IS AS THE SOURCE STATES IT AND NO FIRMER. The source read is QuantumScape's own
newsroom headline. It reports a TEST RESULT under an existing agreement; it is not a
supply contract and is not read as one.
SET `verdict` TO 'accept' OR 'reject' AND THE EDGE MOVES TO THE ROW, or does not.

edge.firmness: agreement in force, test result reported
edge.firmness_note: AS THE SOURCE STATES IT AND NO FIRMER. The page reports that a cell has passed a first endurance test and that PowerCo confirmed the result. That establishes a live technical relationship between the two companies. It does NOT state a licence term, a volume, a date or an exclusivity, and none is read in.
edge.speaker: QuantumScape Corporation
edge.speaker_note: THE SPEAKER IS THE LICENSOR, NOT THE OPERATOR. QuantumScape publishes this about a works it does not own. PowerCo is named as confirming the result, on QuantumScape's page rather than on its own — which is why the speaker is recorded and why the edge is proposed rather than filed.

evidence.verbatim: PowerCo confirms results: QuantumScape's solid-state cell passes first endurance test

edges.why_not_filed: The verbatim is a newsroom headline on an index page, not an article read in full. An asserted edge carries the sentence it was read from, and this register does not write one from a headline without the release behind it. The release is the next thing to read.
